source.mechanics: Effects for Suppressor, Rapid Fire and Dual Wield are computed from the Marvel4 BO1 statistics sheet — the app shows the real numbers per weapon rather than a generic description.
source.note: Unlock requirements are deliberately not listed. Attachment unlocks are weapon-specific kill challenges and no source consulted gave figures worth trusting.

attachments.name: Suppressor
attachments.effect: Removes you from the minimap when firing, and silences the shot.
attachments.cost: Cuts effective range hard — on most weapons the max-damage range drops by 60–70%, which adds a bullet to your shots-to-kill at surprisingly short distances.
attachments.verdict: The most misunderstood attachment in the game. It is not a free stealth upgrade — it is a trade of range for concealment.

attachments.name: Rapid Fire
attachments.effect: Increases rate of fire, typically from 750 to 1000 RPM or 937 to 1250 RPM.
attachments.cost: More recoil and faster magazine drain.
attachments.verdict: Only worth it where the shots-to-kill doesn't change — then it's pure TTK. On a gun you already struggle to control it just spreads your misses more efficiently.

attachments.name: Extended Mag
attachments.cost: None mechanically, beyond the attachment slot.
attachments.verdict: Boring and quietly good. If you are winning fights and then dying to the third enemy while reloading, this is the fix.

attachments.name: Dual Mag
attachments.effect: Two magazines taped together — every other reload is much faster.
attachments.cost: The reload after that is normal speed, so the benefit alternates.
attachments.verdict: Weaker than Extended Mag in most hands, because it only helps on alternate reloads. Fine on high-capacity guns where you rarely reload twice in a fight.

attachments.name: Grip
attachments.cost: Occupies the under-barrel slot, so no Masterkey or launcher.
attachments.verdict: Most valuable on high-recoil, high-damage guns — the AK-47 and the LMGs. Largely wasted on a FAMAS or an AUG that barely kicks.

attachments.name: Reflex Sight
attachments.effect: A clean dot sight with a wide field of view.
attachments.verdict: Preference, not power. Pick the sight whose reticle you can see against the map you're on — Reflex reads best on dark maps.

attachments.name: Red Dot Sight
attachments.effect: A tighter dot with a slightly narrower view.
attachments.verdict: Same as Reflex — down to taste. The genuine argument for any sight is that iron sights on some BO1 guns obscure a lot of screen.

attachments.name: ACOG Scope
attachments.cost: Slower ADS and much harder to use up close.
attachments.verdict: A trap on small maps. In TDM you will be caught at 5 metres by someone you're trying to zoom in on.

attachments.name: Infrared Scope
attachments.effect: Highlights enemies as bright shapes against a dark background.
attachments.cost: Slow to aim, restrictive view, and Ghost Pro users are resistant to it.
attachments.verdict: Situationally strong on dark or cluttered maps where you keep losing enemies against the background.

attachments.name: Variable Zoom
attachments.verdict: Sniper-only, and TDM is rarely the mode for it.

attachments.name: Masterkey
attachments.cost: Uses the under-barrel slot, and the ammo is limited.
attachments.verdict: A genuine answer to the close-range problem on a long-range primary. Worth carrying on an M16 or Galil if you keep getting rushed.

attachments.name: Grenade Launcher
attachments.cost: Under-barrel slot, and it arms only after a short flight distance.
attachments.verdict: Cheap kills, no skill growth, and it teaches you nothing about positioning.

attachments.name: Flamethrower
attachments.effect: A short-range under-barrel flamethrower that applies burn damage.
attachments.cost: Very short range, and Flak Jacket Pro heavily resists it.
attachments.verdict: Novelty. The burn does finish wounded runners, but you're giving up a real attachment for it.

attachments.name: Dual Wield
attachments.effect: Carry two of the weapon, doubling total ammo and output.
attachments.cost: No aiming down sights, and hip-fire spread roughly triples.
attachments.verdict: Only viable at genuinely point-blank range. Outside a doorway fight you will lose to anything aimed.

attachments.name: Extended Clip
attachments.effect: More rounds per magazine on handguns.
attachments.verdict: Sensible on a pistol you actually intend to fight with rather than one carried as a backup.

attachments.name: Snub Nose
attachments.effect: Shortens the Python's barrel for a faster draw and quicker aim.
attachments.verdict: Turns the Python into a genuine panic-button sidearm.

attachments.name: Speed Loader
attachments.verdict: The Python's reload is its worst feature, and this mostly fixes it.

attachments.name: Full Auto
attachments.effect: Converts the CZ75 to fully automatic.
attachments.cost: Damage drops from 40 to 30 and range falls sharply — the CZ75 goes from a 3-shot kill at 15.6m to a 3-shot kill at 5.6m.
attachments.verdict: Looks like an upgrade and mostly isn't. The semi-auto CZ75 kills faster at any range you'd realistically use it.

attachments.name: Upgraded Iron Sights
attachments.effect: Cleaner iron sights with less screen obstruction.
attachments.verdict: Free clarity on guns whose stock irons are cluttered. Unglamorous and often the right pick.
